extracted.intended_audience: research community (applicants, awardees, administrators, early-career scientists) and NIH staff
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance and announced criteria for modernizing the NIH Grants & Funding website to make NIH funding policies, opportunities, and ICO-specific information clearer and easier to navigate for researchers and administrators. Describes goals, completed changes, and next steps for site consolidation, structured ICO profiles, tools, and communications.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reduce time, effort, and complexity
rubrics_metrics.description: Reducing the time, effort, and complexity the research community may face when seeking funding and managing awards, especially those new to the NIH system.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Goal is to streamline user journeys so users—particularly those unfamiliar with NIH—can find what they need faster and with less confusion.

rubrics_metrics.name: Present general information and ICO-specific considerations in one place
rubrics_metrics.description: Allowing researchers and administrators to see both general information and any relevant ICO specific considerations in one place.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Consolidate content so users don't need to navigate multiple independent ICO or NIH sites to get both overarching policies and ICO nuances.

rubrics_metrics.name: Enhance transparency about NIH funding priorities and decisions
rubrics_metrics.description: Enhancing transparency so researchers can more clearly understand NIH funding priorities and decisions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Make priorities, decision drivers, and relevant program information more visible and understandable to help inform research and application strategies.

rubrics_metrics.name: Increase visibility into ICO grants and funding related information
rubrics_metrics.description: Increasing visibility into ICO grants and funding related information.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensure ICO-specific funding opportunities, policies, and priorities are discoverable and prominent within the central site.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reduce duplicated content management burden for staff
rubrics_metrics.description: Allowing staff to more fully focus on programmatic priorities and engagement with the research community, rather than managing similar content across different sites.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Consolidation reduces redundant content authoring/maintenance so staff time shifts to programmatic work and community engagement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Quickly surface eligibility, policies, and ICO considerations for early career scientists
rubrics_metrics.description: An early career scientist exploring workforce-related programs can quickly and easily review general eligibility requirements, relevant NIH-wide policies, and Institute, Center, and Office (ICO)-specific considerations without navigating multiple independent websites.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Design content and navigation targeted to common early-career questions (eligibility, training, loan repayment) with clear links to policy details and ICO nuances.

rubrics_metrics.name: Enable administrators to compare ICO financial management plans consistently
rubrics_metrics.description: An administrator can compare distinctions among ICO financial management plans in a consistent format, reducing the risk of missing important nuances.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Standardize presentation of financial management plans across ICOs so administrators can make side-by-side comparisons without hunting for format or terminology differences.

rubrics_metrics.name: Support researcher navigation across ICO profiles and scientific areas
rubrics_metrics.description: A researcher can move seamlessly through ICO profiles and scientific areas of interest to help inform their research strategies when seeking support.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide structured ICO profiles and topic navigation to help researchers identify relevant ICs and funding avenues aligned to scientific interests.

rubrics_metrics.name: Incorporate content from stand-alone sites into central site
rubrics_metrics.description: Incorporated information on research training, loan repayment, scientific data sharing, public access, and the NIH Extramural Nexus from their own stand-alone sites.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Migrate and integrate topical content (training, data sharing, public access, Nexus) into the Grants & Funding site to centralize authoritative information.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reduce overlapping grants and funding information across NIH/ICO sites
rubrics_metrics.description: Began reducing overlapping grants and funding information across many different NIH and ICO-specific websites.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Audit and remove/merge duplicate content so users find a single authoritative source for a topic rather than conflicting or scattered pages.

rubrics_metrics.name: Provide 'NIH Highlighted Topics' to surface scientific areas ICOs support
rubrics_metrics.description: Launched the NIH Highlighted Topics resource to quickly learn about specific scientific areas that ICOs are interested in supporting.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use highlighted-topic pages (with subscription options) to make ICO priority areas discoverable; include regular updates/alerts to users.

rubrics_metrics.name: Create structured NIH ICO Profile pages with consistent fields
rubrics_metrics.description: Launched new NIH ICO Profile pages with structured and consistent fields for mission statements, general interest areas, listing of highlighted topics, funding opportunities, funding policies and financial management plans, and NIH Guide notices.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use standardized fields across ICO profiles to present mission, interests, topics, opportunities, policies, financial plans, and notices in a uniform, machine- and human-readable way.

rubrics_metrics.name: Deploy tools to find NIH funding opportunities (Explore NIH Grant Opportunities)
rubrics_metrics.description: Deployed the Explore NIH Grant Opportunities tool to quickly identify NIH funding opportunities posted on Grants.gov.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide discovery tools and search tips (e.g., 'Search Tips for NIH Opportunities') to help users efficiently locate relevant Grants.gov postings.

rubrics_metrics.name: Continue migrating ICO-distributed funding information into the central site
rubrics_metrics.description: Continue working with ICO experts to identify and migrate appropriate funding-related information distributed across various websites into the NIH Grants and Funding site.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ongoing collaboration with ICO subject-matter experts to ensure accurate, complete migration of ICO content and to decide what stays centralized vs. ICO-hosted.

rubrics_metrics.name: Expand ICO Profile pages by funding category and policy topic
rubrics_metrics.description: Expand ICO Profile pages to include additional information by funding category and policy topic.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Enhance profile granularity so users can filter or view ICO information organized by funding mechanisms and relevant policy domains.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use Nexus and social channels to communicate about policies and programs
rubrics_metrics.description: Leverage the NIH Extramural Nexus newsletter and new NIH Innovates X and LinkedIn channels to communicate about certain grants and funding policies, programs, initiatives, and related information.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Complement website updates with targeted communications via email newsletters and social platforms to increase reach and timeliness of policy/program announcements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Solicit user input via on-page survey and Nexus inbox
rubrics_metrics.description: We value your input along the way (via the survey available on each page or the Nexus inbox).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide feedback mechanisms (page surveys, Nexus inbox) to gather user experience input and iterate on site content and features.
